questions.question: After absorbing a very slowly moving neutron of mass mN. (momentum = 0) a nucleus of mass M breaks into two nuclei of masses m1 and 3m1 (4m1 = M + mN) respectively. The parent nucleus is initially at rest, so initial momentum Pi = 0.
According to the law of conservation of momentum, final momentum Pp must also be zero.
P1 + P2 = 0
|P1|=|P2|
The magnitudes of the momenta of the two fragments are equal.
The de-Broglie wavelength is given by λ = h/p.
Since both fragments have equal momentum p and h is a constant.
λ1 = λ2 = λ
The de-Broglie wavelength of the other nucleus will be λ

questions.question:
Consider following statements regarding nuclear force :
Statement-I : Saturation of nuclear force is the reason for the constancy of the binding energy per nucleon.
Statement-II : The nuclear binding force has to dominate over the coulomb repulsive force between protons inside the nucleus, to make the nucleus stable.
Correct choice will be :-
options: Both Statement-I and Statement-II are correct.
Statement-I is correct and Statement-II is incorrect.
Statement-I is incorrect and Statement-II is correct.
Both Statement-I and Statement-II are incorrect.
questions.explanation:
Statement-I : “Saturation of nuclear force is the reason for the constancy of the binding energy per nucleon.”
Correct, because each nucleon interacts only with nearest neighbors. This leads to Binding Energy (BE) ∝ Mass Number (A) for a nuclei, which means BE/A roughly constant.
Statement-II : “The nuclear binding force has to dominate over the Coulomb repulsive force between protons inside the nucleus, to make the nucleus stable.”
Correct, because for nucleus stability, attractive nuclear force must overcome repulsive Coulomb force between protons. Otherwise, the protons will not remain inside the nucleus.
Thus, both the statements are correct.

⇒ 12 – b = 8
⇒ b = 4

questions.explanation:
Question Explanation: Identifying the equation for logistic growth.
Concept: Sigmoid growth curve equation
Solution: The sigmoid growth curve, also known as the logistic growth model, is represented by the equation dN/dt = rN(K - N/K). This equation shows that population growth (dN/dt) slows down as the population size (N) approaches the carrying capacity (K). The term (K - N)/K represents the environmental resistance that limits population growth.
Final Answer: dN/dt = rN(K - N/K)
